title: The Silly Mod
description: Adds some colon three-related stuff to the game!
body:
![The Logo for Silly Mod. has the text ACE written on the first L.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9c9760d52f8e9527f47813f04863bf0fe5ca0c06.png)
The Silly Mod!
# What it adds:
- Silly Block
- Silly Ores
- Silly Ingots and Dust
- Liquid Silly
- that's all i guess for now


![liquid silly when flowing texture](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/56063b13550ff8113aa0075bffa680fad9bb2ef6_0.webp) this is how the liquid silly is meant to look like when flowing but i cannot get it to work if someone can help me reach out on the github for my mods :3
